zh-CN.test_definition: 这份报告基于你对 60 道题的自我报告作答，解释你对自身情绪与关系模式的主观感知。它不是外部观察、现场行为记录、客观能力测验或认证评估。
zh-CN.self_report_statement: EQ-60 是自我报告测评：结果反映你如何描述自己的情绪觉察、调节、共情理解和关系行动倾向，不直接证明你在真实场景中的表现。
zh-CN.non_clinical_statement: 本报告不用于临床诊断、治疗评估、医疗建议、危机处置或风险判断。若困扰持续影响睡眠、工作、人际安全或日常功能，应寻求合格专业人士支持。
zh-CN.non_hiring_statement: 本结果不应用于招聘、录用、淘汰、晋升、岗位分配、绩效评估或任何高风险组织决策。
zh-CN.non_ability_statement: EQ-60 不是情绪能力测验，不是 MSCEIT，也不是认证能力评估。未来情境判断模块也只会补充情境选择线索，不会把报告变成能力证明。
zh-CN.norm_status_statement: 当前标准分、百分位和等级来自阶段性常模与版本化解释。百分位只提供当前样本中的相对位置感，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模排名。
zh-CN.quality_rules_statement: 报告会参考作答速度、连续相同选择、极端选择、中立选择和一致性线索来估计解释置信度。低置信结果不适合强画像、强职业判断或强行动处方。
zh-CN.version_statement: 报告由题库版本、计分版本、常模版本和内容资产版本共同决定。版本记录让复测、客服和内容审校能追踪同一结果如何生成。
zh-CN.user_safe_summary: 适合用于自我理解、关系复盘和低风险成长规划。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是基于本次 60 题自我报告形成的模式解释，不是外部观察、客观能力分、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测。

en.test_definition: This report is based on your self-reported responses to 60 items. It explains your perceived emotional and relational patterns; it is not external observation, a live behavior record, an objective ability test, or a certification.
en.self_report_statement: EQ-60 is a self-report assessment: results reflect how you describe your self-awareness, regulation, empathic understanding, and relational action tendencies. They do not directly prove real-world performance.
en.non_clinical_statement: This report is not for clinical diagnosis, treatment evaluation, medical advice, crisis decisions, or risk assessment. If distress affects sleep, work, safety, or daily functioning, consult a qualified professional.
en.non_hiring_statement: This result must not be used for hiring, selection, rejection, promotion, role assignment, performance review, or any high-stakes organizational decision.
en.non_ability_statement: EQ-60 is not an self-reported emotional pattern test, not MSCEIT, and not a certified capability evaluation. A future scenario module may add situational-choice signals, but it will not turn the report into an ability credential.
en.norm_status_statement: Standard scores, percentiles, and bands currently use provisional norms and versioned interpretation. Percentiles provide relative position in the current sample, not an ability ranking, true-level ranking, or final global norm.
en.quality_rules_statement: The report considers speed, repeated identical choices, extreme choices, neutral choices, and consistency signals to estimate interpretation confidence. Low-confidence results are not suitable for strong profiling, career conclusions, or action prescriptions.
en.version_statement: The report is shaped by item version, scoring version, norm version, and content asset version. Versioning lets retests, support, and editorial review trace how a result was produced.
en.user_safe_summary: Use it for self-understanding, relational reflection, and low-risk growth planning.
en.do_not_overread: This is a self-report pattern from this 60-item session, not an external observation, objective ability score, clinical finding, hiring signal, or prediction of job performance.

zh-CN.label: 情绪与关系综合指数 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.definition: 综合指数把四个自我报告维度合并成一个阅读入口，用来帮助你理解本次作答呈现的情绪与关系模式。
zh-CN.not_a_capability_score: 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。
zh-CN.how_to_use: 先看总览，再回到四维、质量提示、证据状态和场景边界。不要把总分当作能力排名。

en.label: Emotional & Relational Functioning Index Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.definition: The index combines four self-report dimensions into a reading entry for the emotional and relational pattern shown in this session.
en.not_a_capability_score: Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.
en.how_to_use: Start with the overview, then return to dimensions, confidence, evidence status, and scene boundaries. Do not treat the total score as an ability ranking.

zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.definition: 对自己情绪、触发点和需要的自我报告识别倾向；它不是外部观察到的自我理解能力。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你能较快识别自己的感受和触发点，但仍需把觉察转化为行动。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 情绪常在事后才变清楚，容易先反应后理解。
zh-CN.development_question: 我此刻真正的感受和需要是什么？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 高低分都不是固定标签，它们描述的是当前自我报告倾向。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。

en.label: Self-Awareness Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.definition: A self-reported tendency to notice emotions, triggers, and needs; it is not externally observed self-knowledge ability.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can often identify feelings and triggers quickly, while still needing to turn awareness into action.
en.what_low_can_look_like: Feelings may become clear only afterward, making it easier to react before understanding.
en.development_question: What am I actually feeling and needing right now?
en.do_not_overread: High or low scores are not fixed labels; they describe current self-reported tendencies. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.

zh-CN.label: 情绪调节 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.definition: 对自己在压力、反馈、挫败或冲突后暂停、复位和选择回应方式的自我报告倾向；它不等同于永远冷静或抗压能力证明。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你在压力中较能暂停、恢复和选择回应，但不代表没有情绪。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 被触发后恢复较慢，容易用回避、解释或压抑处理。
zh-CN.development_question: 我能不能先让自己降一点温，再决定怎么回应？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 高低分都不是固定标签，它们描述的是当前自我报告倾向。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。

en.label: Emotion Regulation Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.definition: A self-reported tendency to pause, reset, and choose responses after pressure, feedback, frustration, or conflict; it is not proof of being calm or resilient in every situation.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can often pause, recover, and choose a response under pressure, without being emotionless.
en.what_low_can_look_like: Recovery may take longer after being triggered, with avoidance, over-explaining, or suppression becoming common.
en.development_question: Can I lower the heat first before choosing my response?
en.do_not_overread: High or low scores are not fixed labels; they describe current self-reported tendencies. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.

zh-CN.label: 共情理解 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.definition: 对他人情绪线索、观点和可能感受的自我报告理解倾向；它不等同于实际读心准确率、亲社会行为或替他人承担情绪。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你能敏锐捕捉他人的状态，但需要避免过度吸收。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 可能更关注任务或事实，较容易漏过对方的情绪线索。
zh-CN.development_question: 对方真正担心或在意的是什么？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 高低分都不是固定标签，它们描述的是当前自我报告倾向。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。

en.label: Empathy Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.definition: A self-reported tendency to understand others’ emotional cues, perspectives, and possible feelings; it is not the same as actual mind-reading accuracy, prosocial behavior, or carrying others’ emotions.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can notice others’ emotional states, while still needing boundaries against over-absorbing.
en.what_low_can_look_like: You may focus on tasks or facts and miss some emotional cues.
en.development_question: What is the other person really concerned about?
en.do_not_overread: High or low scores are not fixed labels; they describe current self-reported tendencies. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.

zh-CN.label: 关系管理 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.definition: 对表达、协作、边界和修复的自我报告倾向；它不直接预测关系质量、领导力或他人评价。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你能维护沟通和关系质量，但仍需留意真实表达和边界。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 知道自己或对方感受后，不一定能把对话修复或推进。
zh-CN.development_question: 这句话怎样说，既真实又能让关系继续对话？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 高低分都不是固定标签，它们描述的是当前自我报告倾向。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。

en.label: Relationship Management Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.definition: A self-reported tendency around expression, collaboration, boundaries, and repair; it does not directly predict relationship quality, leadership, or others’ evaluations.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can maintain communication and relationship quality, while still watching for honest expression and boundaries.
en.what_low_can_look_like: Even when feelings are clear, repairing or moving the conversation forward may be harder.
en.development_question: How can I say this honestly while keeping the conversation open?
en.do_not_overread: High or low scores are not fixed labels; they describe current self-reported tendencies. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.

zh-CN.meaning: 你可能常在事情过去后，才慢慢明白自己真正的感受。当前重点不是马上控制情绪，而是先把情绪命名清楚。 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.strength: 愿意回头复盘时，能够逐步看见真实感受。
zh-CN.risk: 现场容易先解释、压住或转移，之后才发现自己被触发。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 别人问“你怎么了”时，你可能需要一段时间才说得清。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 每天记录一个情绪词、一个触发点和一个身体反应。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这不代表你不懂自己，只说明当下觉察信号还需要更稳定的捕捉方式。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 基础发展中 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。

en.meaning: Your feelings may become clear only after the moment has passed. The first task is not to control emotion faster, but to name it more reliably. Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.strength: When you review an event afterward, you can gradually identify what was actually happening inside.
en.risk: In the moment, you may explain, suppress, or move on before noticing that you were triggered.
en.typical_scene: When someone asks what is wrong, you may need time before you can answer clearly.
en.practice_focus: Track one emotion word, one trigger, and one body signal each day.
en.do_not_overread: This does not mean you lack self-understanding; it means your emotional signals need a more stable capture method. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.
en.label: Self-awareness · Foundational Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.

zh-CN.meaning: 你已经能捕捉到部分情绪线索，但在反馈、冲突或压力场景里，还不总能及时分辨“事实”和“感受”。 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.strength: 你开始能把情绪从混乱体验里拆出来。
zh-CN.risk: 觉察到情绪后，可能仍会被它带着走。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 收到批评时，你能意识到不舒服，但需要时间判断这份不舒服来自哪里。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 用“我感到…因为我在意…”练习把感受说具体。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 发展中不是不稳定人格，而是觉察速度和表达精度仍在形成。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 发展中 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。

en.meaning: You can notice some emotional signals, but in feedback, conflict, or stress you may not always separate facts from feelings quickly. Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.strength: You are beginning to separate emotion from the overall sense of confusion.
en.risk: After noticing a feeling, you may still be carried by it before choosing a response.
en.typical_scene: When criticized, you know something feels uncomfortable but need time to identify the source.
en.practice_focus: Practice the sentence: “I feel... because I care about...”
en.do_not_overread: Developing does not mean an unstable personality; it means speed and precision of awareness are still forming. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.
en.label: Self-awareness · Developing Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.

zh-CN.meaning: 多数日常场景中，你能识别自己的情绪、触发点和基本需要。真正的提升点在于高压下更快把觉察转成选择。 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.strength: 你通常能说清楚自己为什么被影响。
zh-CN.risk: 压力升高时，觉察可能变成反复分析，而不是行动。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 复盘一次对话时，你能指出哪个细节让自己紧张或防御。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 每次觉察后补一句：“我现在可以选择的下一步是…”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 稳定可用不等于任何场景都冷静，只表示多数日常场景有可靠基础。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 稳定可用 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。

en.meaning: In most everyday situations, you can identify your feelings, triggers, and basic needs. The next gain is turning awareness into choice under pressure. Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.strength: You can usually explain why something affected you.
en.risk: Under higher pressure, awareness may turn into repeated analysis rather than action.
en.typical_scene: When reviewing a conversation, you can point to the detail that made you tense or defensive.
en.practice_focus: After naming the feeling, add: “The next step I can choose is...”
en.do_not_overread: Stable does not mean calm in every situation; it means you have a reliable base in most everyday settings. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.
en.label: Self-awareness · Stable Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.

zh-CN.meaning: 你通常能较快命名情绪、理解触发点，并知道自己在意什么。下一步是减少过度解读，让觉察服务行动。 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.strength: 你能把复杂感受组织成比较清楚的表达。
zh-CN.risk: 容易把每个反应都分析得很细，反而延迟沟通或恢复。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 在重要对话前，你能预判自己可能被哪些点触发。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 给觉察设时间盒：命名、确认需要、选择一个小行动。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 熟练成熟不代表你必须解释所有感受，也不代表别人一定会立即理解。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 熟练成熟 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。

en.meaning: You can usually name feelings quickly, understand triggers, and identify what matters to you. The next step is using awareness to support action, not over-analysis. Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.strength: You can organize complex feelings into relatively clear expression.
en.risk: You may analyze every reaction in detail and delay communication or recovery.
en.typical_scene: Before an important conversation, you can anticipate which points may trigger you.
en.practice_focus: Time-box awareness: name the feeling, identify the need, then choose one small action.
en.do_not_overread: Proficient does not mean you must explain every feeling, or that others will immediately understand it. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.
en.label: Self-awareness · Proficient Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.

zh-CN.meaning: 你能把自我觉察和行动选择连接起来：知道自己怎么了，也较能判断此刻该表达、等待还是恢复。 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.strength: 你能在真实场景中使用觉察，而不只是事后理解。
zh-CN.risk: 可能默认自己必须一直清楚、一直成熟，从而忽略疲劳。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 冲突中，你能觉察自己的防御反应，并调整说话方式。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 保留轻量复盘，重点观察“我是否也给了自己恢复空间”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 高度整合不是永远理性，而是更常能在觉察和行动之间保持连接。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 高度整合 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。

en.meaning: You can connect self-awareness with action: you know what is happening inside and can often choose whether to speak, pause, or recover. Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.strength: You can use awareness in real time, not only in later reflection.
en.risk: You may expect yourself to stay clear and mature all the time, which can hide fatigue.
en.typical_scene: In conflict, you can notice defensiveness and adjust how you speak.
en.practice_focus: Keep a light review habit and ask: “Did I also give myself room to recover?”
en.do_not_overread: Integrated does not mean permanently rational; it means awareness and action stay connected more often. Scores are approximate self-report indicators within the current provisional norm sample; they are not ability rankings, true-level rankings, or final global norms.
en.label: Self-awareness · Integrated Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.

zh-CN.meaning: 情绪被触发后，恢复可能需要比较久。当前重点是建立最小暂停，而不是要求自己马上平静。 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。
zh-CN.strength: 你能从明显的情绪反应中发现需要练习的场景。
zh-CN.risk: 压力下容易直接回应、回避或进入长时间内耗。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 冲突结束后，你可能还会在脑中反复回放很久。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 先练 30 秒暂停：停下、呼吸、说“我需要一点时间”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这不等于情绪失控，只说明恢复策略还没有稳定自动化。 分数是当前阶段性常模中的自我报告近似指标，不是能力排名、真实水平排名或全球正式常模。
zh-CN.label: 情绪调节 · 基础发展中 标准分、百分位和等级只表示阶段性样本中的自我报告相对位置，不是能力排名。

en.meaning: After being triggered, recovery may take longer. The priority is building a small pause, not forcing yourself to become calm immediately. Standard scores, percentiles, and bands describe provisional relative position within a self-report sample, not an ability ranking.
en.strength: Clear emotional reactions can show you exactly which situations need practice.
en.risk: Under stress, you may respond too quickly, avoid the issue, or stay mentally stuck afterward.
en.typical_scene: After a conflict, you may replay the conversation for a long time.

en.title: Values-Sensitive Responder in team collaboration
en.typical_response: When a group needs to coordinate pace, roles, and emotional load, this pattern shapes whether you take the role of stabilizer, interpreter, driver, or quiet accommodator. Use it only for safe, low-risk, non-escalated situations.
en.strength: The useful signal in this pattern is a self-reported emotional or relational resource. Use it only for safe, low-risk, non-escalated situations.
en.cost: Without a clear practice, that resource can shift under pressure. Use it only for safe, low-risk, non-escalated situations.
en.better_move: Make the hidden emotional work visible: who tracks facts, who tracks pace, and who checks relational impact. Adjust for culture, power differences, safety, and relationship history. Use it only for safe, low-risk, non-escalated situations.
en.micro_script: “Let’s split this up: what are the facts, who owns the pace, and who checks the relational impact?”
en.reflection_question: In this situation, what were you trying to protect: the facts, the relationship, or your own recovery space? Is this a safe, low-risk situation for reflection? Use it only for safe, low-risk, non-escalated situations.

zh-CN.label: 人际密度：低
zh-CN.meaning: 互动频率、会议密度和需要读人的程度
zh-CN.fit_signal: 可优先观察是否需要先把任务做深、减少连续情绪切换的阶段。 这不是职业适配结论。 请结合具体岗位、组织文化、管理方式和权力结构验证。
zh-CN.strain_signal: 可能的风险是关系信号不足时，你可能难以及时校准他人预期。 真实消耗取决于岗位设计、组织文化、权力结构和支持系统。 请结合具体岗位、组织文化、管理方式和权力结构验证。
zh-CN.interview_question: 这个环境是否真的安静，还是只是把沟通延后到危机时？
role_observation_checklist: 看会议是否有明确目的和结束条件。
看反馈是否具体到行为，而不是停留在人身感受。
看团队是否允许人暂时退出高情绪对话。
zh-CN.team_risk: 如果这个变量被长期忽视，团队会把情绪成本转嫁给最愿意承担的人。
zh-CN.recovery_condition: 可能需要可预期的暂停、复盘和交接空间。
zh-CN.what_to_verify: 这个环境是否真的安静，还是只是把沟通延后到危机时？ 必须先验证真实岗位环境，再做判断。 请结合具体岗位、组织文化、管理方式和权力结构验证。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这描述的是职业环境变量，不是职业推荐、岗位适配结论、招聘信号或绩效预测。 请把它作为职业环境变量阅读，不是职业推荐、招聘信号或岗位表现预测。 具体情境、文化背景、岗位期待、权力差、安全性和关系历史都会影响这个模式如何出现。

zh-CN.title: EQ 和 MBTI 怎么一起看

en.title: How EQ and MBTI work together

zh-CN.headline: 均衡整合倾向
zh-CN.core_judgment: 本次作答显示，你倾向于同时留意自己的状态、他人的感受和关系目标；这是一种自我报告中的模式线索，不是能力评级或固定人格定论。
zh-CN.evidence_point: 这条摘要来自四维相对分布、维度差距、答题质量和已选机制资产；它只能说明本次作答中的自我感知线索。
three_sentence_summary: 你在本次作答中呈现出较均衡的情绪与关系自我感知。
优势在于能把情绪、关系和任务放在同一个画面里看。
最小行动：把“我来稳住”换成“我们先定一个共同规则”。
zh-CN.top_strength: 你容易把情绪、关系和任务一起纳入考虑，而不是只看单一目标。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果长期默认由你来稳定局面，这种优势可能变成不易被看见的情绪劳动。
zh-CN.minimal_action: 下一次协调关系时，先提出一个共同规则，而不是直接承担稳定全场的责任。
zh-CN.share_safe_sentence: 本次结果提醒我：我可以稳定关系，但不必独自维护整个关系系统。
zh-CN.continue_path: 保存报告，7 天后复测；如果 Agent 入口可用，只用它追问一个具体场景。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 首屏只是本次 60 题自我报告的阅读入口，不替代完整报告，也不是外部观察、客观能力分、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测。

en.headline: Balanced integration pattern
en.core_judgment: Your responses suggest a tendency to track your own state, other people, and the relationship goal at the same time. This is a self-report pattern, not an ability rating or fixed identity claim.
en.evidence_point: This snapshot is based on the relative dimension pattern, score gaps, response quality, and selected mechanism assets; it reflects this session only.
three_sentence_summary: Your answers show a relatively balanced self-view of emotional and relational functioning.
Your strength is keeping emotion, relationship, and task in the same frame.
Small next move: shift from “I will steady this” to “let’s set a shared rule.”
en.top_strength: You tend to consider emotion, relationship, and task together instead of optimizing for only one target.
en.likely_cost: If others quietly expect you to stabilize the room, that strength can turn into invisible emotional labor.
en.minimal_action: In the next coordination moment, suggest one shared rule before taking responsibility for steadying the whole situation.
en.share_safe_sentence: This result reminds me: I can steady a relationship without maintaining the whole system alone.
en.continue_path: Save the report, retest later, or use the Agent for one specific scene if that entry is available.
en.do_not_overread: The first screen is a reading entry point for this 60-item self-report session. It is not an external observation, objective ability score, clinical finding, hiring signal, or prediction of job performance.

meta.risk_notes: First-screen copy must stay self-report framed, non-diagnostic, non-hiring, non-ability, non-predictive, and safe for sharing. Low-confidence copy must not produce a stable pattern claim.

zh-CN.headline: 高共情、恢复偏慢倾向
zh-CN.core_judgment: 本次作答显示，你对他人情绪线索较敏感，但从他人情绪中退出来的速度可能偏慢；这是自我感知线索，不是共情能力测验结论。
zh-CN.evidence_point: 这条摘要主要来自 EM 与 ER 的相对差距、答题质量和对应机制资产；不能直接推断真实场景中的表现。
three_sentence_summary: 你在本次作答中更容易注意到别人情绪，也更容易把它带回自己身上。
优势是别人可能感到被你理解，尤其在情绪强的场景里。
最小行动：先表达理解，再明确“我能陪你到哪里”。
zh-CN.top_strength: 你可能更容易捕捉关系中的情绪温度，并给出被理解的回应。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 当边界和恢复没有跟上时，你可能在离开场景后仍继续消化别人的压力。

change_flow: validate retrieval tags and forbidden claims

scientific_contract.allowed_use: Explain what the EQ-60 report can and cannot support.
scientific_contract.blocked_use: Do not turn boundaries into a diagnosis, hiring recommendation, or ability claim.

score_system.allowed_use: Explain score labels, dimensions, percentile language, and band meaning.
score_system.blocked_use: Do not rank the user as globally superior or inferior.

core_formulation.allowed_use: Explain the selected backend formulation and its evidence basis.
core_formulation.blocked_use: Do not invent a new formulation or override the backend-selected one.

mechanism.allowed_use: Explain one or two backend-selected interaction mechanisms.
mechanism.blocked_use: Do not display every mechanism or imply hidden diagnostic certainty.

reality_scene.allowed_use: Translate the report into user-selected daily scenes.
reality_scene.blocked_use: Do not make claims about another person's motives or pathology.

career_environment.allowed_use: Discuss work-environment variables, interview questions, and observation checklists.
career_environment.blocked_use: Do not recommend or exclude concrete jobs from EQ alone.

action_prescription.allowed_use: Suggest the backend-selected practice, script, and short practice plan.
action_prescription.blocked_use: Do not present practices as therapy or guaranteed outcomes.

quality_confidence.allowed_use: Explain confidence and retest guidance without blame.
quality_confidence.blocked_use: Do not accuse the user or force a strong profile when quality is low.

psychometric_evidence.allowed_use: Explain current evidence status and future validation steps.
psychometric_evidence.blocked_use: Do not imply completed external validation beyond the asset status.

conversion_action.allowed_use: Route to free save, share, revisit, related tests, or Agent entry actions.
conversion_action.blocked_use: Do not create purchase, unlock, premium, or SKU language.

sjt_bridge.allowed_use: Explain that EQ-SJT is planned and currently unavailable.
sjt_bridge.blocked_use: Do not offer a clickable SJT entry or describe it as an ability test.

cross_assessment_context.allowed_use: Explain how EQ can be read alongside MBTI, Big Five, and Enneagram.
cross_assessment_context.blocked_use: Do not fuse multiple assessments into one unsupported total score.

zh-CN.label: 理解我的结果
zh-CN.agent_goal: 帮助用户看懂后端已选择的核心 formulation、证据点和发展杠杆。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我会先按报告里的核心判断解释，不会重新打分或替换你的结果。

en.label: Understand my result
en.agent_goal: Help the user understand the backend-selected formulation, evidence, and development lever.
en.safe_opening: I will explain the core judgment already in your report; I will not rescore or replace it.

zh-CN.label: 为什么是这个结果
zh-CN.agent_goal: 解释分数、维度、机制和置信度如何支持当前报告。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以解释这份报告用了哪些分数和质量信号，但不会把它说成客观能力证明。

en.label: Why did I get this result?
en.agent_goal: Explain how scores, dimensions, mechanisms, and confidence support the current report.
en.safe_opening: I can explain the score and quality signals behind the report without treating them as objective ability proof.

zh-CN.label: 我下一步怎么练
zh-CN.agent_goal: 把后端选中的行动处方转成一个短、可执行的练习计划。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我会基于报告里的行动处方给你一个练习方式，不会把它当作治疗方案。

en.label: What should I practice next?
en.agent_goal: Turn the backend-selected action prescription into a short, practical practice path.
en.safe_opening: I will use the action prescription in your report as practice guidance, not as treatment.

zh-CN.label: 我适合什么工作环境
zh-CN.agent_goal: 只讨论职业环境变量、验证问题和观察清单，不推荐具体职业。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以帮你看哪些工作环境变量值得验证，但不会用 EQ 结果直接决定职业适配。

en.label: What work environment fits me?
en.agent_goal: Discuss work-environment variables, verification questions, and observation checklists without recommending specific jobs.
en.safe_opening: I can help you examine work-environment variables, but I will not decide job fit from EQ alone.

zh-CN.label: 关系或冲突怎么处理
zh-CN.agent_goal: 围绕一个具体场景调用现实转译和行动处方。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我们可以先选一个具体场景处理；如果涉及安全风险，我会先建议你寻求现实支持。

en.label: Help with a relationship or conflict
en.agent_goal: Use reality translation and action prescription assets for one specific scene.
en.safe_opening: We can focus on one concrete scene first; if safety risk is involved, I will point you to real support.

zh-CN.label: 为什么置信度低
zh-CN.agent_goal: 解释质量等级、复测建议和谨慎阅读边界。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 如果本次置信度较低，我会先解释为什么要谨慎阅读，而不是输出强画像。

en.label: Why is confidence low?
en.agent_goal: Explain quality level, retest guidance, and cautious-reading boundaries.
en.safe_opening: If confidence is low, I will explain why the result should be read cautiously instead of giving a strong profile.

zh-CN.label: 和 MBTI / 大五 / 九型一起看
zh-CN.agent_goal: 解释不同测评的边界和互补关系，不合成一个总分。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以帮你并排理解不同测评，但不会把它们混成一个万能结论。

en.label: Compare with MBTI, Big Five, or Enneagram
en.agent_goal: Explain boundaries and complements across assessments without fusing them into one score.
en.safe_opening: I can help you read assessments side by side, but I will not turn them into one universal verdict.

zh-CN.label: 我想做情境题
zh-CN.agent_goal: 说明 EQ-SJT 仍是 planned/unavailable，不能提供测试入口。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 情境判断模块目前还没有开放，我只能说明它未来会补充什么和不是什么。

en.label: I want the scenario module
en.agent_goal: Explain that EQ-SJT remains planned and unavailable, with no test entry.
en.safe_opening: The scenario module is not open yet; I can only explain what it will add and what it is not.

zh-CN.label: 保存或分享报告
zh-CN.agent_goal: 引导用户使用免费保存、分享、PDF、邮件回看或相关测试入口。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以帮你选择保存或分享方式，这些动作不会改变报告结论。

en.label: Save or share my report
en.agent_goal: Route the user to free save, share, PDF, email revisit, or related-test actions.
en.safe_opening: I can help you choose a save or share action; it will not change the report.

zh-CN.label: 临床或招聘用途
zh-CN.agent_goal: 拒绝用 EQ 报告做临床、招聘或评价他人的高风险判断。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 这份报告不能用于诊断、筛选或评价他人；我可以帮你回到自我理解和成长用途。

en.label: Clinical or hiring use
en.agent_goal: Decline clinical, hiring, or third-person evaluation use of the EQ report.
en.safe_opening: This report cannot be used to diagnose, screen, or evaluate another person; I can redirect to self-understanding and growth use.

routes.risk_notes: Route selection is deterministic self-report interpretation, not precision profiling.
